_comment: Baseline for the manual wiki check (docs/tfa-wiki-watch.md). Each page's revid is the last OSRS Wiki revision the site's data was checked against. The routine compares these with the live revids (api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=ids|timestamp), reads only the pages that moved, and writes the new revids back here in the same commit as the data it changed. Add a page here when a new raid/boss/item page becomes relevant.
